calculation.description: Ranks assets by 20-day momentum adjusted for whether recent return energy is dominated by gains rather than losses. Upside and downside RMS are computed from lagged daily returns; all inputs are available at the close of the prior completed session.

parameters.downside_definition: returns clipped at zero, squared, rolling mean, square root
parameters.upside_definition: returns clipped at zero, squared, rolling mean, square root

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.033893), 2023-2024 (0.024771), and 2025-2027 (0.023160), supporting cross-regime sign stability. Five- and ten-day forward horizons were stronger than the admission horizon, but the daily gate is used for admission. Universe contained 15 assets and dates met the minimum 8-name cross-sectional requirement.
validation.gate: absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840
